This schema-1 share invite was emitted by iris-drive's Rust core using
`create_shared_folder`, `invite_shared_folder_member`, and `parse_share_invite`.
It exercises the signed `iris-drive/share-access` event and native NIP-44 wraps.

The public test secret keys are 32 bytes of `01` (owner) and `02` (recipient).
The share, owner, and recipient UUIDs end in `001`, `002`, and `003` respectively.
All names and key material are disposable test data. The two content-key epochs
were generated by the native implementation; tests decrypt the newest wraps for
both devices to verify compatibility without relying on ciphertext randomness.
